diagnosis.root_cause: shop-proxy's live Caddy configuration was changed through the admin API to reverse_proxy shop-web:8001, while shop-web listens on port 8000. The live upstream therefore refused connections and caused the 502 responses; the on-disk Caddyfile retains the working port 8000 configuration.
